groups.defect: In AssertEvents, the isAccessTokenId matcher reads the grant shortcut at substring(3,5) when it should read substring(4,6). Its equality check is also inverted, so it returns false when the shortcut matches. Two members add extra defects. s_843e5d06 says the matcher can throw StringIndexOutOfBounds when the ID prefix is short. s_9fe47bb1 says the '4th char' code comment is misleading and should be corrected.

answer.reasoning:
All seven suggestions point at the same line (AssertEvents.java:483, the isAccessTokenId matcher). Each reports the same core defect: the substring offset is wrong (3,5 instead of 4,6) and the comparison is inverted. So they form one same_location group, and both judges agree on that.

The judges only disagree on needsUnifiedComment. Two members report defects that the others do not:
- s_843e5d06 says the matcher can throw StringIndexOutOfBounds on short IDs.
- s_9fe47bb1 says the misleading '4th char' comment should be corrected.

s_16105147, s_48023927 and s_dedf90ac only add a length guard inside their proposed fix. That does not count as reporting a separate defect. Still, because some members report extra defects that are not shared, the merged comment has to carry more than any single member says. So needsUnifiedComment is true.
